profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Airbnb | ex - Apple 
profile.summary: Front end engineer passionate about building interactive, accessible, and pixel-perfect websites (corporate-slang for making cool, pretty websites for all 😉).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web
positions.description: Building out tools to onboard hotels onto Airbnb at scale.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
As a Front End Engineer, I worked to develop components, tools, and experiences for apple.com, working closely with design and product to make pixel perfect products.
 
Some of my technical accomplishments are:
· Coordinated with design/product to launch pages on .com, reaching over a billion visits across 90+ locales.
· Built a reusable, accessible component library to streamline workflows via an enterprise-grade CMS.
· Developed a tool for copywriters to update copy on .com - reducing developer involvement.
· Owned the pricing API, enabling real-time updates across all pages - reducing manual updates.
· Collaborated on revamping an internal web animation library used by 200+ developers.
· Authored documentation that sped up onboarding and improved developer contributions.

In addition to my day-to-day job as an engineer, I also:
· Led and emceed an engineering conference with 300+ participants, promoting knowledge-sharing/collaboration.
· Led community/culture initiatives as a Community Lead for Apple's Asian ERG.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Communication · JavaScript · Programming · Problem Solving · TypeScript · Software Engineering Practices · Software Architecture · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SASS · React.js

positions.title: Web Engineer, Internal Tools
positions.description:
On the internal tools team, I worked in a micro-frontend platform (React, TypeScript, GraphQL) enabling independent tooling for marketing, product, customer support teams, and more.

Some of my technical accomplishments are:
· Led development of an order management page with real-time updates, cancellations, and refunds - integrating with backend APIs.
· Led a project with Target to allow shoppers to pick up multiple orders simultaneously, improving operational efficiency.
· Implemented a mini CMS for marketing - streamlining campaign creation and reducing developer dependency for updates.

positions.title: Web Engineer, Growth
positions.description:
On the Growth/Product team, I worked on various features to improve new user retention and to improve the customer shopping experience on shipt.com.

Some of my technical accomplishments are:
· Developed gift card pages, collaborating with designers and researchers to optimize UX and conversion rates via A/B testing.
· Revamped the web header component which contained various features like our search bar, store location, delivery time, etc. — working closely with designers, backend, and user testers.

positions.title: Head Coding Instructor
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
·  Taught over 100 students in various programming languages including Javascript, Arduino C, Java.
·  Conceptualized and created two week Arduino curriculum for creating a self watering plant from start to finish.
·  Organized and led bi-weekly trips to tech companies in New York including Venmo, Etsy, and Google.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:
· Administered and held office hours for the introductory computer science
course at WashU with 500+ students enrolled.
· Proctored exams and graded 200+ exams and 300+ labs.

company.name: Washington University McKelvey School of Engineering

honors.title: Art Awards
honors.description: Won multiple awards and scholarships in art competitions sponsored by corporations, news outlets, etc.
